notes: First 50-file slice: 26 English and 24 German documents from all seven sources, mixed original formats and six paragraph-only Markdown notes. Each 2–4-word file-name query is a half-remembered known item; grade 2 only for its file. Initial positive-only labels; further queries and judgments belong to later passes. The byte digest covers every original; probe passages use only Markdown notes verified through the real extraction/index lifecycle. The lang group denotes target-document language, including queries that borrow the other language's vocabulary or word order.
